rationale: The response maintains an indignant sworn-testimony tone, addresses the Chair, reframes the act as patriotic/customizing store goods (mentions Publix, Cornflower Blue CorningWare, Pyrex) and refuses to grovel or name names. quote: I chopped celery, Mr. Chairman! I added fresh dill! I sprinkled smoked paprika across the top in a decorative, zig-zag pattern that screamed "sweated over a hot stove!"
